cap: Mo checked his phone *96 times* a day, for a crowd that wasn't even *looking.*
say: Mo checked his phone ninety-six times a day, for a crowd that wasn't even looking.

cap: You see, every drawing he posted turned into a *scoreboard.*
say: You see, every drawing he posted turned into a scoreboard.

cap: And the score was *likes.*
say: And the score was likes.

cap: Monday, he posts a *dragon.*
say: Monday, he posts a dragon.

cap: *Nine likes.*
say: Nine likes.

cap: He *deletes* it.
say: He deletes it.

cap: Tuesday, he redraws it for *three hours,* posts at *2 AM.*
say: Tuesday, he redraws it for three hours, posts at two A.M.

cap: *Eleven.* Better.
say: Eleven. Better.

cap: Wednesday, he checks in *class,* at *dinner,* in the *shower.*
say: Wednesday, he checks in class, at dinner, in the shower.

cap: By Friday, he isn't drawing anymore. He's just *refreshing.*
say: By Friday, he isn't drawing anymore. He's just refreshing.

cap: *96 checks.* Zero drawings.
say: Ninety-six checks. Zero drawings.

cap: His little sister asks if the phone pays *rent* now.
say: His little sister asks if the phone pays rent now.

cap: He doesn't laugh. Because in his head, there's a *stadium.*
say: He doesn't laugh. Because in his head, there's a stadium.

cap: Thousands of seats, every one of them *watching him,* waiting for him to *mess up.*
say: Thousands of seats, every one of them watching him, waiting for him to mess up.

cap: But here's where it gets *weird.*
say: But here's where it gets weird.

cap: Walk up into those seats and look *closer.*
say: Walk up into those seats and look closer.

cap: *Nobody's* looking at Mo.
say: Nobody's looking at Mo.

cap: Every single one of them is staring at their *own phone.*
say: Every single one of them is staring at their own phone.

cap: Counting their own likes. Scared of their *own crowd.*
say: Counting their own likes. Scared of their own crowd.

cap: It's called the *spotlight effect.*
say: It's called the spotlight effect.

cap: You feel like the whole world is watching, when almost *nobody* is.
say: You feel like the whole world is watching, when almost nobody is.

cap: *Nobody was watching.*
say: Nobody was watching.

cap: And that was the *good news.*
say: And that was the good news.

cap: So Mo puts the phone face down, picks up his pencil, and for once, he doesn't *check.*
say: So Mo puts the phone face down, picks up his pencil, and for once, he doesn't check.
